svg.title: Common continuation after Direct or hierarchical posting
svg.desc: Direct or hierarchical posting returns to a common grid-strided output-index clear and prefix grid join. If Direct tail CTAs already forwarded local traffic, skip the second copy pass. Otherwise perform deferred source-local LSA forwarding and done publication. A CTA-local join, not another grid barrier, precedes receive work.
svg.text: After posting: initialize outputs, join, and finish source-local delivery
Direct posting returns
done + strong VA update submitted
Hierarchical posting returns
Relay publication + terminal submitted
All CTAs · all threads: clear outRecvTopkIdx to −1
Grid-strided full-capacity clear; submitted network traffic can progress independently.
Prefix grid join · cooperative_groups::this_grid().sync()
Completes local initialization; this is not a remote-delivery wait.
parallelLocal = true
Direct tail CTAs already forwarded locally
Local done is already published; skip another pass.
parallelLocal = false · deferred local forwarding
Warp 0: hierBuildForwardDestinations
CTA: ncclLsaCopy header/payload, then write ready tags
CTA: hierPublishDone; warp 0 writes local done
A ready tag alone does not publish completion.
CTA-only join · coop.sync() → receive work
No second grid-wide barrier; receivers acquire each producer’s completion.
This forwards the source’s own tokens within its LSA domain. Remote relay forwarding is receive-side work.
CTA roles change across phases; the same cooperative launch performs all of this work.
